frequency_question: How often do authorities activate a non-zero CCyB within a designated 30-month horizon after maintaining it at 0% for an extended expansionary phase?
membership_rule: Members are G20/Basel Committee jurisdictions that established a CCyB framework post-2010, starting from a 0% rate during non-crisis expansions, observed over any rolling 30-month window.

cases.name: United States (Federal Reserve post-pandemic expansion window)

coverage_note: 5 named early-adopter jurisdictions activated; 2 instances of US Fed maintaining 0% through equivalent windows.
known_gaps: US regulatory inertia and distinct reliance on stress testing (CCAR/DEPR) rather than the standalone CCyB instrument creates a structural divergence from European peers.
skeleton: Jurisdictions with fully operational macroprudential frameworks meeting credit-to-GDP gap or systemic risk warning precursors versus those executing activation.
multiplier: 7 observed major jurisdiction activation cycles with established macroprudential mandate frameworks.
validity_reason: Matches the exact resolution horizon for the target question.
